summary: A mixed day with significant judicial developments on climate and accountability, alongside regulatory focus on food safety labeling and Reliance's IPO approval. Key legal and retail compliance issues dominate.

bullets.text: CJI Surya Kant warns climate crisis will test existing laws; calls for displaced persons' legal status recognition.
Nestle CEO urges scientific consultation on India's front-of-pack food warning labels amid regulatory debate.
Food safety body demands problem-fixing over blame as hygiene violations plague prominent Indian restaurants.
Markets regulator approves Jio Platforms' $3.8 billion IPO amid Subhash Chandra-Reliance dispute allegations.
Judicial Transparency Index reveals gaps in judge disciplinary accountability mechanisms in Indian courts.
